0.title: Rules
0.body: Leaf & Let Die — Blind Playtest v37.01. Start by taking the Rulebook PDF out of the Game Box Sack and following its First Game instructions. The Game Box placard is an approximate packaging simulation; all game trays and player supplies are arranged on it for unpacking.
